scope: A9 public synthetic dataset external human-review receipt binding preparation
initial_finding: The public manifest required a review_receipt_sha256 but the supported CLI could not consume or bind the referenced receipt bytes.
fixes: Added a versioned, additional-field-closed external public review receipt schema.
Bound exact receipt bytes to the manifest receipt SHA and exact dataset/version/count/split/reviewer/time fields.
Rejected pending-manifest receipt use and receipt use outside public-dataset-status before provider dispatch.
Kept receipt integrity separate from unverified human authority and review completion.
remaining_external_gates: Actual owner review and externally authoritative receipt/decision for the public corpus
Real provider run and independent request/non-transfer evidence
